distribution.narrative: Yang (2020) lists Sichuan; accepted as mainland-China occurrence evidence from a specialist Cryphalus checklist.

host_note: Existing 殷蕙芬等 (1984)/黄复生等 (2015) host evidence for Picea asperata is retained. Yang (2020) contributes distribution evidence only and supplies no host data.
